description:
You are a process safety engineer. A recent HAZOP study identified missing safety and process equipment on the Methanol Storage Tank T-100.

Open the diagram '~/Diagrams/methanol_storage.drawio' and the requirements file '~/Desktop/hazop_recommendations.txt'.

Update the P&ID diagram to include the following missing equipment using the 'Process Engineering' or 'P&ID' shape libraries (you may need to enable these libraries via 'More Shapes'):

1. Install a Pressure Relief Valve (PSV) on the top of the tank. Tag: PSV-101
2. Install a Centrifugal Pump on the tank outlet line. Tag: P-101
3. Install a Check Valve immediately downstream of the pump. Tag: V-102
4. Install a Shell and Tube Heat Exchanger downstream of the check valve. Tag: E-101

Connect all components with solid lines (pipes) to show the flow: Tank -> Pump -> Check Valve -> Heat Exchanger -> Exit.

Ensure all new shapes have text labels matching their tags (e.g., 'P-101').

Finally, export the updated diagram as a PDF to '~/Diagrams/methanol_storage_rev1.pdf'.
